auth: API key in Authorization header (free account at etdata.org)
notes: Host reachable, /openapi.json public (35.6 kB, 20 paths). No key -> 403 {'detail':'Not authenticated'}; INVALID key -> HTTP 500 Internal Server Error, so a bad key is indistinguishable from a server fault. CONUS/48-state coverage only since Dec 2025 - Iowa/Illinois were NOT covered before that. Members: Ensemble, eeMETRIC, geeSEBAL, SSEBop, SIMS, DisALEXI, PT-JPL. reference_et=gridMET.

DAP4 group path is /MOD_Grid_MOD16A2/Data_Fields/ET_500m - a bare /ET_500m CE returns Hyrax 400. 301x301 subset = 238 kB in 4.2 s. NO _FillValue attribute: mask on valid_range [-32767,32700]*0.1 or the domain mean is 55 mm/day instead of 3.60 mm/day (15x).

Collection mixes Terra (MOD) and Aqua (MYD) - filter on the id prefix or you average two sensors. COGs are uint16 nodata 65535 but the HDF fill 32767 survives: mask >32700. 2022 domain tile h11v04 gives p5/p50/p95 = 401/606/762 mm/yr masked vs 1279 mm/yr naive. Whole-tile read 27.8 s; use windowed reads. Sign with /api/sas/v1/sign?href=... - manually appending the /token/<coll> string gave 403. OPeNDAP also serves this annual product (MOD16A3GF.A2022001.h11v04.061 DMR 200, 33.6 kB), so PC is a convenience rather than the only HDF4-free route: use OPeNDAP for spatial subsets, PC COGs for whole tiles.
The non-gap-filled twin of MOD16A2GF. Use it for anything inside the last year; GF lags ~1 year.

variable: ETdaily (mm/d), PTJPLSMinst/canopy/soil/interception, STICinst, BESSinst, MOD16inst, ETinstUncertainty
notes: 28,233 granules over the domain box. BUT: of 16 granules over S1's tile 15TXF in Jun-Aug 2024, mean valid fraction 28.6%, only 8 of 16 >10% valid, and only 2 of 16 were both daytime (9-15 LST) and >10% valid. The pre-dawn granule (05:13 LST) is 99.9% valid with median ETdaily = 0.00 mm/day - averaging granules without a local-solar-time filter drives the domain mean toward zero. The 2024-07-31 midday granule downloads cleanly as a 19 kB file with 161/2,458,624 valid pixels (0.007%). ETinstUncertainty is ~70% of ETinst. Tiles are MGRS in the local UTM zone (15TXF -> EPSG:32615, 16TBK -> EPSG:32616); CMR bbox matching returns tiles that only graze the domain (16TBK spans 39.6-40.6N).
10,308 granules over the domain but the newest is 2026-02-05 while ECO_L3T_JET runs to 2026-09-15 - production appears to lag or have stopped. Check before planning on it.
28,263 granules over the domain; same sampling caveats as ECO_L3T_JET.

640 files: m<YYYYMM>.zip = actual ET, ma<YYYYMM>.zip = anomaly. m202407.zip is 10.9 MB in 9.8 s and holds one GeoTIFF (m202407.modisSSEBopETactual.tif). Directory index is plain HTML - regex the hrefs. The annual/downloads/ sibling path 404s; edcintl root is 403.
222 files, same naming. CONUS product is the one to use here.

variable: Qle, Qh, Evap, PotEvap, TVeg, ESoil, ECanop, RootMoist, SoilM_*, LAI, GVEG, CCond, RCSOL (54 vars)
notes: netCDF4 (not GRIB) in v2.0. 7.35 MB/hour, 4.8 s each; a full day is 169 MB in 206 s. Domain subset is 19x61 cells. Only source here that carries the ET PARTITION: on 2024-07-31 the domain split was TVeg 79% / ECanop 17% / ESoil 4%. Directory listing needs the bearer token. Caveat for H4: Noah's GVEG and LAI are MODIS climatology, so NLDAS cannot represent interannual crop variability by construction.

1,944 domain cells. A CE with no index range returns the whole 1624x3856 global grid: 24 MB in 6.2 s for 5 variables - add [y0:y1][x0:x1] to cut it. land_evapotranspiration_flux is kg/m2/s (1.05e-4 -> 9.04 mm/day); consistent with heat_flux_latent 258 W/m2. The legacy host n5eil01u.ecs.nsidc.org is unreachable even after allowlisting - use data.nsidc.earthdatacloud.nasa.gov or OPeNDAP.
4,194 granules over the domain. Carries carbon fluxes, not LE - use SPL4SMGP for latent heat.

18,028 domain cells. .idx byte-range search pulls 4 fields in 6.5 s instead of a 130 MB GRIB2. Herbie renames to cfgrib short names: LHTFL->slhtf, SHTFL->ishf, GFLUX->gflux, VEG->veg. Longitudes are 0-360. At 18Z 2024-07-31 HRRR LHTFL = 216 W/m2 against NLDAS Qle = 375 W/m2 - a 1.7x spread between the campaign's two candidate forcings at the same timestamp.

variable: lwir11 (ST_B10), atran, emis, red, nir08, qa_pixel
notes: 20 scenes with cloud<15% over the S1 box Jun-Sep 2024. A 418x579 windowed read of lwir11 took 2.4 s; ST = DN*0.00341802 + 149.0 K. Mean 28.4 C at S1 on 2024-09-09. THIS is the working route: the USGS LandsatLook STAC search also works (22 landsat-c2l2-st scenes Jul-Aug 2024) but its https hrefs 302 to ers.cr.usgs.gov interactive login and the s3://usgs-landsat alternate is requester-pays.

auth: none for search; ERS login or requester-pays S3 for data
notes: 14 collections including landsat-c2l2-st and the ARD variants. Use it for discovery/metadata; take the pixels from Planetary Computer.

NAMING TRAP: grass reference ET is pet_YYYY.nc, NOT eto_YYYY.nc (which 404s). pet_2024.nc is 70.3 MB (49.7 s), etr_2024.nc 93.1 MB; server supports byte ranges so /vsicurl or h5netcdf range reads work. Variable name inside is potential_evapotranspiration; lat descends so slice(42.7, 40.4). Domain = 10,248 cells; 2024-07-31 domain-mean ETo = 4.61 mm/day. This is OpenET's and SSEBop's reference-ET denominator.
SILENT STALENESS: the PC mirror stops at 2020-12-31 while native gridMET runs to the present. A pipeline written against it will simply return nothing for campaign years.
Water-balance actual ET. Useful as a long climatology; also stops in 2021 on PC.

variable: E, Et, Eb, Ei, Ep, S
notes: www.gleam.eu is not on the sandbox allowlist and distribution is by SFTP after a registration form, which this sandbox cannot do. Not verified. At 0.1-0.25 deg it is also too coarse to resolve the Ames-Chicago land-use gradient; treat as a sanity check, not a map source.

cds.climate.copernicus.eu is not allowlisted and no CDS credential is configured. The Planetary Computer 'era5-pds' collection is reachable but its 14 variables contain NO evaporation or latent-heat field, so it is not a substitute. Not verified.

variable: site metadata, BASE variable list, published data years
notes: SUPERSEDES the 'AmeriFlux unreachable' note in derechos-data-sources: amfcdata.lbl.gov and ameriflux-data.lbl.gov still fail, but amfcdn.lbl.gov works. v1 site_display = 844 sites (299 kB); v2 site_info_display = 844 richer records (1.69 MB) carrying base_variables (so you can test 'LE' membership directly), grp_publish_base (the exact published data years), publish_ameriflux_policy (CCBY4.0 vs LEGACY), status, DOIs, and planting/harvest dates in grp_igbp.igbp_comment. country is 'USA' and state is a 2-letter code - filtering on 'United States'/'Iowa' returns nothing.

variable: LE, H, G, NETRAD, SWC, FC (half-hourly)
notes: Live and validating: an empty body returns 422 naming exactly four required fields - user_id, user_email, data_policy, data_product. agree_policy is client-side only (the server rejects it as 'Unknown field'). Not exercised because it logs an identified user; register an AmeriFlux account and supply the real id. act.discovery.download_ameriflux_data wraps this.

NAME TRAP: the b1 datastream is sgpecorsfE33.b1 (with 'sf'), NOT sgpecorE33.b1 - the latter returns status 'success' with zero files. Active SGP facilities E33, E37, E39 (2019-10 -> present); sgpecorsfwind*.a1 carries the wind data but a-level is not served by ARM Live. One day = 87.6 kB in 0.7 s.

variable: net radiation, soil heat flux, soil moisture
notes: Active at E12, E14, E32, E33, E37, E39. E12/E32 SEBS start 2024-12-09/11, exactly as EBBR ends.

The 31-year SGP Bowen-ratio ET record ENDS 2024-12-10 (E12, E32 last; E13 ended 2023-12-18). Any 'out-of-domain training analogue' built on EBBR is a historical record, not a concurrent one for 2027-2029. Use ECOR + SEBS for the campaign period.

variable: et (in/day), solar, precip, soil temp/VWC at 4/12/24/50 in
notes: ENDPOINT CORRECTION to derechos-data-sources: /agclimate/isusm.py returns a PNG plot for these parameters; the data endpoint is /cgi-bin/request/isusm.py. 2024 full year at FRUI4+CRFI4 = 732 rows, 119 kB, no gaps and no -99 sentinels in the et column. et is in INCHES/day. JJA 2024 means: FRUI4 (S1) 5.02, CRFI4 (M1) 4.82 mm/day; annual max 11.2-11.4 mm/day, which is reference-ET magnitude, not actual ET. Treat et as a reference/potential ET diagnostic - it is NOT an eddy-covariance constraint. The dead deep-VWC sensors at FRUI4 (pinned at 1.00) are unrelated to the et column.

notes: Station metadata pages are public (stnmetadata.asp, 21 stations); cdflist.asp is a login page and every PET path tried (/warm/pet/, /warm/weekly/pet.asp, /warm/datafile.asp) 404s. Needs an ISWS data account or a direct transfer via co-author Trent Ford.
